title: nasturtium spinosum
intro: Nasturtium spinosum, commonly known as the thorny nasturtium or globe flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Tropaeolaceae. The plant's flowers, leaves, and stems have been traditionally used for their medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nasturtium spinosum include its ability to act as a diuretic, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include compounds like triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
